name: Al Maddah
description: Saber Al Maddah is a devout and beloved man whose life is turned upside down when the devil exploits his love for a woman, driving him to kill those closest to her in a moment of uncontrollable rage. Haunted by prophetic dreams and thrust into a war with supernatural forces, Saber must battle the jinn and the daughters of Satan across a journey that blurs the line between faith, love, and the unseen world.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Hasan admonishes Saber for trying to kill him in his dream, as Saber mentions that he had dreamt the exact same thing. Manal suffers a second miscarriage.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Saber travels to Marsa Alam despite being unstable following his brother’s death. Manal asks Hasan to leave her and marry someone who can bear him children.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Seeking answers to his perplexing questions, Saber talks to Shaikh Abdulrahman. Later, he crosses paths with a girl he saw in his dreams.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Bodour attacks Saber and warns him of the ramifications of breaking a vow. Saber meets Sheikh Abdulrahman, who advises him to bring himself closer to God.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Rihab meets her father in the desert. Saber performs an exorcism on Budoor as the police arrest Manal.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: When Safa finds out that Salam is not Saber’s father, she tries to confront an elusive Afaf. Elsewhere, Jameela is arrested for assault.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Saber confronts Muneer but ends up being in a tough spot. Dr. Hamdy agrees to repeat the exam for Suhaila. Meanwhile, Saber turns to Abul Khair to help Jameela.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: After reprimanding Rihab and ordering her to go back to Cairo, Muneer confronts Saber and threatens him. Later, Rihab is shaken by bad news.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: After Abul Khair questions Saber’s innocence, the latter sees another vision. Jameela meets Rihab to deliver a message from Saber.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Rihab makes arrangements to release Saber from jail. Hasan is forced to make a tough decision. Jameela tries to convince Saber to stop searching for Adel.
